title: Complete the P0 placeholder inventory

description: Inventory empty visitors, unsupported clone surfaces, default or generated constants, direct unsupported lowering, verifier gaps, and affected tests; classify each finding without changing language semantics.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every in-scope placeholder is classified as dead syntax, intentional no-op, typed unsupported boundary, or implementation debt with owner and focused evidence.

acceptance_criteria.text: The inventory identifies one smallest independently acceptable cluster without combining unrelated parser, Sema, IR, runtime, or IDE work.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The smallest independent closure is IR loop-control legality in the verifier: SGBreak and SGContinue loop-context checks plus focused verifier tests, with no parser, Sema, runtime, IDE, or feature-semantics expansion.

title: Select the first compiler closure

acceptance_criteria.text: One cluster is approved and represented by a separate group with one design Node, bounded implementation Nodes, and one final-validation Node.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Maintainer approved the IR loop-control verifier closure; group de49005d-35bb-42a7-8e99-b349d7e47a7c contains one design Node, one bounded implementation Node, and one final-validation Node.
